messages:
Leah B: quick design drop for prompt-sets regression view. key changes: compact diff toggle, inline comment rail, separate 'mark approved' flow. please skim for copy & accessibility before we freeze.

Omar N: copy nit: modal currently 'Approve changes'  could read as 'deploy'. suggest title 'Mark selected prompt sets as approved' and primary CTA 'Mark as approved'.

Tess K: a11y: danger button contrast 3.6 on current token. modal doesn't set aria-hidden on background. also need aria-live on diff summary so screen readers hear updates.

Victor H: UX: bulk mode auto-select is surprising. prefer explicit select-all checkbox. multiline diffs: default side-by-side, with compact inline toggle.

AuditBot: automated scan:
 - --color-danger-600 contrast 3.6 (fail)
 - modal background not aria-hidden
 - diff-summary missing aria-live

Leah B: owners/dates:
 - change modal copy + two-step flow: Tess K - due Tue
 - fix contrast token and badge styles: Victor H - due Mon
 - add aria-hidden & focus trap + aria-live on summary: Omar N - due Mon
 - change bulk select behavior + select-all: Victor H - due Wed

Omar N: I'll add focus-trap.activate/deactivate and store/restore activeElement.

Tess K: small copy tweak: per-test CTA "Approve" -> "Mark test as approved". Also add aria-label to failing badge (e.g., '3 failing tests').

Leah B: thanks team. demo Friday after fixes. merging blocked if AuditBot still flags contrast or focus traps. :sparkles:
